Definition: from G1021; to delay:--be slack, tarry.
BiblicalUsage: Here is bradýnō, the word for to delay, to tarry. It turns up in 1 Timothy, and the meaning is as plain as the word is short.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bradýnō is small but not slight: to delay, to tarry is part of the picture too.
